Enum Class IconSpecsFas3

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<IconSpecsFas3>
org.patternfly.icon.IconSpecsFas3
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<IconSpecsFas3>, Constable
@Generated("generate.mjs") public enum IconSpecsFas3 extends Enum<IconSpecsFas3>
Icon specifications for Fontawesome solid icons.

You probably won't need to use this class directly, but instead work with IconSets.fas.

See Also:
